Sam (eng-security): Heads-up: vendor pen-test inbound. Retest slot Mon 09:00-13:00 UTC. Need three confirmations by Fri EOD: ephemeral RBAC for assessors, KMS decrypt gating for evidence, and audit export + retention. Also set deployment freeze and rollback policy.

Diego (eng-sre): I can create `pt-assessor-temp` role. Scoped to `arn:aws:s3:::sec-evidence/pt-2026-201/*` with s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket. Max session 6h. Will require sts:TagSession and tag `pt_vendor=true`.

Sam (eng-security): Good. For KMS: prefer CMK condition `aws:RequestTag/pt_vendor = "true"` so decrypt is only allowed when the session tag is present. Can we do that + a short-lived grant?

Diego (eng-sre): Yes. I'll add the CMK policy condition and issue a KMS Grant bound to the role ARN. Grants are revocable which helps during the engagement. Example condition I will use: "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/pt_vendor": "true"}}.

Rina (eng-ops): Logging plan: CloudTrail + app JSON logs + ALB -> `s3://sec-evidence/pt-2026-201/raw/`. Retention 90d hot, archive 1y. We'll run a scrub job to remove PII before export. I'll do a dry-run Wed 16:00 UTC and post a presigned sample.

Hannah (eng-platform): Deployment freeze: Mon 07:00-15:00 UTC. Canary: auto-rollback if 5xx > 1% for 3m or p50 latency increases > 150ms. Also add fallback route to smaller model. Will publish runbook and calendar block.

sec-bot: Pen-test intake SEC-2026-201 created. Evidence bucket `redwood-pt-2026-201`. Dry-run scrub Wed 16:00 UTC. Oncall: @Diego. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/security/tickets/SEC-2026-201

Diego (eng-sre): I'll post role ARN + KMS grant ID after adding sts:TagSession enforcement. Presigned manifest for large artifacts will be under `pt-2026-201/manifest.json` with TTL 12h.

Rina (eng-ops): Dry-run scheduled. If scrub needs tweaks I'll ask for small delay. Will share presigned sample link here after vet.

Sam (eng-security): Owners: Diego = role + KMS grant + presigned manifest; Rina = scrub dry-run + lifecycle + SIEM hookup; Hannah = freeze + canary + runbook. Readiness check Fri 18:00 UTC in #eng-security. Checklist: role ARN, KMS grant/policy, presigned manifest, scrub sample, lifecycle + CloudTrail, freeze visible, evidence README. Flag blockers here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
